description: Subset of ECC commands converted to Pi prompt templates for the initial SDD/quality port.

commands.name: plan-prd
adaptations: Kept .claude/prds output path for ECC SDLC compatibility; noted as configurable/open question for Pi-only workflows.
Replaced Claude-specific handoff phrasing where needed and clarified that /plan-prd and /plan are Pi prompt templates in this port.
No subagent, hook, or MCP dependency required.

commands.name: plan
adaptations: Preserved inline-by-default planning; removed/rewrote Task-tool subagent delegation to inline analysis.
Normalized references to Pi commands/skills (e.g. /tdd-workflow skill, /code-review, /test-coverage) instead of Claude-only agent invocation.
Kept .claude/plans artifact path for compatibility and documented artifact-path considerations.

commands.name: prp-implement
adaptations: Retained file-driven implementation/validation workflow executable with Pi read/bash/edit/write tools.
Replaced any Claude subagent assumptions with direct inline execution steps.
Kept .claude/PRPs report/plan paths as source-compatible artifacts; noted portability considerations.

commands.name: feature-dev
commands.blockedReason: Original multi-agent orchestration (code-explorer/code-architect/code-reviewer) runs inline or via run_agent; no automatic 3-agent pipeline.
adaptations: Converted agent-delegation phases to inline guidance using Pi tools (read/grep/find/bash/edit/write) so it can be followed without subagents.
Marked original multi-agent orchestration as degraded/blocked until delegation support is added.
Removed Task-tool-specific instructions.

commands.name: code-review
commands.blockedReason: PR mode relies on GitHub CLI/API access and network connectivity; local review is fully usable.
commands.unblocksAt: Stage 4+ — environment with gh auth/network and optional MCP/GitHub tooling; PR publish automation may also benefit from hook/command integrations.
adaptations: Preserved local and PR review modes with Pi-friendly tool usage.
Made gh/network-dependent PR fetch/publish steps explicitly conditional and documented fallbacks (review diff locally, produce report without publishing).
Normalized artifact/report path guidance for Pi workspace compatibility.

commands.name: test-coverage
adaptations: Kept framework-detection and coverage workflow; expressed as inline steps using Pi bash/read/edit/write tools.
Clarified that verification quality depends on project test tooling being installed locally.
No subagent, hook, or MCP dependency required.

commands.name: quality-gate
commands.blockedReason: Original command wrapped the ECC hook runtime; the hooks adapter now runs the gate on edit/write and the template keeps an inline fallback.
adaptations: Converted to a Pi prompt template that explains the limitation and provides inline formatter-check alternatives (Biome/Prettier/gofmt/ruff) via bash when available.
Documented ECC hook-script invocation as unavailable in this Pi port unless hook bridge/scripts are wired.
Added explicit blocked status and unlock stage.

notes.tdd: No ECC command named tdd exists under ecc/commands; TDD is provided by the tdd-workflow skill (available in pi/core). Not convertible from ecc/commands without modifying ./ecc.
notes.verify: Mapped to test-coverage for this subset as a practical verification/quality command; verification-loop remains available as a skill.
